prompt:
Use case: compositing / ui-mockup.
Asset type: one conceptual in-game HUD mockup for Tequila Kill, a top-down western pixel-art arena game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: keep its full arena composition, warm sand, grey-stone saloon interiors, wooden furniture, rocks, fences, lighting and top-down pixel-art mood. Input image 2 is an IDENTITY REFERENCE for Poncho. Input image 3 is an IDENTITY REFERENCE for Garcia. Redraw the portraits in a coherent refreshed expressive pixel-art style; do not simply paste the old portraits.

Primary edit: overlay four compact player information panels DIRECTLY ON TOP OF THE GAME IMAGE, one in each corner. The arena continues behind the panels. Preserve a wide landscape 16:9 game-screenshot composition. The center of the fight and the green tequila bottle remain clearly visible.

HUD layout proposal:
- Upper left: J1 PONCHO, cyan accent.
- Upper right: J2 GARCIA, red accent.
- Lower left: J3 PONCHO, violet accent.
- Lower right: J4 GARCIA, golden-yellow accent.
- Each panel occupies approximately 22 percent of screen width and 15 percent of screen height, with a small inset margin. Thin dark wood/paper pixel borders, subtle dark translucent backing, warm off-white legible pixel text, restrained western ornament.
- Every panel contains ALL five elements: a NEW square expressive face portrait, a visible row of bullet/shell icons showing loaded and spent ammunition, a horizontal health bar labeled VIE, a compact DASH icon with its availability/cooldown, and a character skill icon labeled SPRINT for Poncho or CROSSE for Garcia. Show a few differing health/ammo/cooldown states to explain the design. Ammo counts are illustrative, not balance specifications.
- Use small precise clear labels only: J1 PONCHO, J2 GARCIA, J3 PONCHO, J4 GARCIA, VIE, DASH, SPRINT, CROSSE. No explanatory paragraphs.
- Keep the panels compact and convincingly superimposed over gameplay. There is NO full-width bottom band, NO separate HUD strip, NO reserved black margin, NO big title screen, NO developer controls.

Characters:
Exactly four arena avatars, using only the two established characters twice each: two Ponchos and two Garcias, NOT four distinct characters. Poncho has a wide pale sombrero with olive crown and brown fringed poncho. Garcia has a dark hat, blue-violet outfit, red scarf, strong moustache in his portrait. Replace the two anonymous research avatars in the target image with these duplicates. Each avatar has a small ground marker matching its panel accent and a player-number marker so its panel can be identified. One central Poncho carries the green bottle with a restrained ivory carrier highlight; keep the battle readable. Redraw the HUD portraits using the old portrait identities but fresh, polished matching pixel-art faces.

Style and invariants:
Crisp pixel-inspired edges and warm western colors matching the target, consistent portrait and UI rendering. Preserve the arena and active battlefield across the entire frame; the HUD sits over it in the corners. Maintain the image proportions and top-down viewpoint. This is a polished design preview of placement, not a production sprite sheet or an implementation screenshot. No logos, no watermarks, no extra panels or characters.
technical_note: Maquette conceptuelle. Le projet cible 640 × 360 ; l'image ne garantit pas une grille pixel exacte ni les dimensions finales de l'interface.
